text.ms:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan  Peraturan-Peraturan
Francais (Lembaga Penasihat Francais) (Saraan Anggota) 2025.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 13 Mac 2025.

Tafsiran

2. Dalam Peraturan-Peraturan ini, melainkan jika konteksnya menghendaki makna
yang lain—

"anggota Lembaga" ertinya anggota Lembaga Penasihat Francais yang dilantik di
bawah seksyen 35 Akta;

"Lembaga" ertinya Lembaga Penasihat Francais yang di tubuhkan di bawah
seksyen 35 Akta;

"mesyuarat" ertinya  apa-apa mesyuarat, perbincangan, lawatan  atau bengkel,
yang diadakan tidak kurang daripada dua jam bagi maksud menjalankan fungsi Lembaga
menurut subseksyen 36(1) Akta;

"saraan" ertinya apa -apa elaun atau kemudahan kewangan yang boleh diterima
oleh atau dibayar kepada anggota Lembaga menurut subseksyen 35(4) Akta bagi apa-apa
perbelanjaan bagi menghadiri mesyuarat dan termasuklah apa-apa perbelanjaan bagi
makanan dan minuman, penginapan, tiket penerbangan atau tuntutan perjalanan.

Mesyuarat Lembaga

3. (1) Lembaga hendaklah bermesyuarat sekurang-kurangnya satu kali
dalam setahun.

(2) Satu pertiga daripada bilangan anggota Lembaga hendaklah membentuk
korum, termasuklah Pengerusi.

Saraan

4. (1) Anggota Lembaga yang menghadiri mana-mana mesyuarat Lembaga
hendaklah dibayar apa-apa saraan sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

(2) Walau apa pun subperaturan (1), jika anggota Lembaga yang dilantik
merupakan seorang pegawai awam, pembayaran apa -apa saraan berhubung dengan
apa-apa elaun hendaklah dibuat mengikut pekeliling perkhidmatan yang sedang
berkuat kuasa.

JADUAL
[Peraturan 5]
KADAR SARAAN (ELAUN DAN KEMUDAHAN)

1. Elaun kehadiran bagi setiap mesyuarat yang dihadiri oleh anggota Lembaga
ialah RM1,000.00

FRANCHISE ACT 1998

FRANCHISE (FRANCHISE ADVISORY BOARD) (MEMBERS' REMUNERATION)
REGULATIONS 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 35(4) and section 60 of the
Franchise Act 1998 [Act 590], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Franchise (Franchise  Advisory
Board) (Members' Remuneration) Regulations 2025.

(2) These Regulations come into force on 13 March 2025.

Interpretation
2. In these Regulations, unless the context otherwise requires—

"members of the Board" means the members of the Franchise Advisory Board
appointed under section 35 of the Act;

"Board" means the Franchise Advisory Board established under
section 35 of the Act;

"meeting" means any meeting, discussion, visit  or workshop, held not less than
two hours for the purpose of exercising the functions of the Board pursuant to
subsection 36(1) of the Act;

"remuneration" means any allowance or financial facilities that may be acceptable
by or paid to the members of the Board pursuant to subsection 35(4) of the Act for
any expenses to attend meeting and includes any expenses for food and beverages,
accommodation, flight ticket or travel claim.

Meeting of the Board
3. (1) The Board shall meet at least once a year.

(2) One third of the numbers of the members of the Board shall form a quorum,
including the Chairman.

Remuneration
4. (1) The members of the Board who attended the meeting of the Board shall be
paid any remuneration as specified in the Schedule.

 (2) Notwithstanding subregulation (1), where the member of the Board
appointed is a public officer, the payment of any remuneration in relation to any
allowance shall be made in accordance with the service circular for the time being in force.

SCHEDULE
[Regulation 5]
REMUNERATION RATES (ALLOWANCES AND FACILITIES)

1. Allowance for each meeting attended by members of the Board is RM1,000.00.

2. Payment for accommodation, travel ing claims and air tickets facilities for each
